source_row.rationale: The transition from nursing student to independently practicing nurse is a well-recognized period of vulnerability, often associated with "transition shock." Structured onboarding support (such as extended orientation, mentorship, and regular check-ins) specifically tailored for newly licensed graduate nurses has been associated in research with improved confidence, more effective competency development, and better retention outcomes.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Structured New Graduate Onboarding
source_row.source_name: AACN / ANCC — New Graduate Nurse Transition Support Evidence
source_row.stem: A hospital provides structured onboarding support, including an extended orientation period and regular check-ins, specifically for newly licensed graduate nurses, and an experienced nurse assumes this extra support is really just unnecessary hand-holding for people who should already know what they're doing.
